# Youtube Data Analysis

## Procedure
Use Data API for accessible public counts; owned Analytics API or CSV for retention/engagement when offered. Normalize by publication age and metric definition; missing fields remain missing.

## Evidence and safety
Never invent access, API responses, metrics, sources, or licenses. Label estimates and confidence. Follow approval gates in `CLAUDE.md` and produce an explicit result plus next test.
